entities.summary: Michael Pittman Jr. is an American professional football wide receiver for the Pittsburgh Steelers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the USC Trojans, earning consensus second-team All-American honors as a senior. He was selected by the Indianapolis Colts in the second round of the 2020 NFL draft.
